simple.meaning: מִכְסֶה (mikçeh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a covering , i.e. weatherboarding.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 8:13. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִכְסֶה (H4372) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מִכְסֶה (mikçeh) / H4372 is traced through Genesis 8:13, Exodus 26:14, Exodus 35:11, Exodus 36:19 with generated occurrence evidence.
